0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGSIGNBOARD_00135_NO_PERMIT_TO_BUY1
0.description: In order to purchase a plot of land privately, you must have at least one class at level 50.
0.translation_description: Per acquistare privatamente un lotto di terreno, devi avere almeno una classe al livello 50.

1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGSIGNBOARD_00135_NO_PERMIT_TO_BUY2
1.description: Furthermore, you must hold a rank of second lieutenant or above in one of the Grand Companies.
1.translation_description: Inoltre, devi essere sottotenente o superiore in una Grande Compagnia.

2.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGSIGNBOARD_00135_KUGANE_NOT_OPENED
2.description: At present, Shirogane is open for display only. Land sales will commence at a later time.
2.translation_description: Al momento Shirogane è aperta solo per visite. La vendita dei lotti inizierà più avanti.

3.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGSIGNBOARD_00135_KUGANE_NOT_ARROWED_TO_BUY
3.description: In order to purhase a plot in Shirogane, you must first complete the main scenario quest “Not without Incident.”
3.translation_description: Per acquistare un lotto a Shirogane, devi prima completare l'incarico della storia principale «Not without Incident».

4.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGSIGNBOARD_00135_ISHGARD_NOT_OPENED
4.description: At present, Empyreum is open for display only. Land sales will commence at a later time.
4.translation_description: Al momento è possibile visitare Empyreum, ma la vendita dei lotti inizierà più avanti.

5.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGSIGNBOARD_00135_ISHGARD_NOT_ARROWED_TO_BUY
5.description: In order to purchase a plot in Empyreum, you must first complete the main scenario quest “Litany of Peace.”
5.translation_description: Per acquistare un lotto a Empyreum, devi prima completare l'incarico della storia principale «Litany of Peace».

6.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGSIGNBOARD_00135_LAND_LOTTERY_LOTTED
6.translation_description: Hai presentato un'iscrizione alla lotteria per il lotto <hex:022003E80403>, distretto <hex:022003E80303>, <hex:022825FF0A506C6163654E616D65FF17022813FF0E5465727269746F727954797065E80206030103>. Il tuo numero di partecipazione è <hex:022003E80503>. I risultati saranno disponibili dal <hex:020703E80603><hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03>:<hex:022402DA03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> <hex:02082BE4E94E04FF12022002DC032F022002DE032F022002DF03FF12022002DE032F022002DC032F022002DF0303>.

7.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGSIGNBOARD_00135_LAND_LOTTERY_LOTTED_2
7.description: The status of your lottery entry can be confirmed at any time via the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Estate<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> tab of the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timers<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> interface located under <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> in the main menu.
7.translation_description: Puoi controllare in qualsiasi momento lo stato della tua iscrizione alla lotteria dalla scheda <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Proprietà<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> dell'interfaccia <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timer<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, accessibile dal menu principale sotto <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Incarichi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

8.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGSIGNBOARD_00135_LAND_LOTTERY_REFUND_FULL_GIL
8.description: Unable to claim refund. You cannot carry any more gil.
8.translation_description: Impossibile riscuotere il rimborso: non puoi trasportare altro gil.

9.name: TEXT_CMNDEFHOUSINGSIGNBOARD_00135_LAND_LOTTERY_GUIDE
9.description: You have submitted a lottery entry for a different plot. Please confirm the status of your lottery entry by accessing the same placard by which you entered the lottery.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Pending Entry:<hex:02100103>Plot <hex:022003E80403>, Ward <hex:022003E80303>, <hex:022825FF0A506C6163654E616D65FF17022813FF0E5465727269746F727954797065E80206030103>
9.translation_description: Hai presentato un'iscrizione alla lotteria per un altro lotto. Controllane lo stato alla stessa targa a cui hai presentato l'iscrizione.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Iscrizione in sospeso:<hex:02100103>Lotto <hex:022003E80403>, Distretto <hex:022003E80303>, <hex:022825FF0A506C6163654E616D65FF17022813FF0E5465727269746F727954797065E80206030103>
